name: HealthPlanOne (Partner)
assessment:
There will be an assessment and interview with the recruiter. They will be asked about how they meet sales goals, how they handle objections, a time they had to overcome an objection to make the sale, the interview will focus on previous experiences. 
Once they apply, their resume will be reviewed, if selected for an interview it is on the phone. If offered a role they must be licensed before joining a class. Classes are 1-2 times a month depending on time of year. This is primarily for AEP and employees who did not perform well will be furloughed on Dec 9th.
